description: Browser or phone frame with the live page at the device's real width.

howToUse: Use it to show a page working inside a browser window or a phone, at the real width of the device.
Pass the page in `src` with a `frameTitle`, and the device size in `viewport`; it scales to fit.
The page inside does not react to clicks. Offer a link to open it for real.
alternatives: A plain screenshot with no frame: an `` in AspectRatio.

keyboard.action: The page inside does not receive focus.

props.name: variant
props.description: `browser`: window with an address bar; `phone`: device with a rounded screen.

props.name: src
props.description: Live page: rendered by an iframe at the real width and scaled to fit.

props.name: viewport
props.description: Real screen width and height, in px (default 1280×800 in the browser, 390×844 on the phone).

props.name: children
props.description: Static content in place of the iframe (e.g. a real capture of a native app).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
